title: tripleurospermum maritimum subsp. inodorum
intro: Tripleurospermum maritimum subsp. inodorum, commonly known as Sea Cudweed or Sea Mayweed, is a subspecies of plant in the daisy family that grows near the coastlines and is often found in sandy areas. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Sea Cudweed include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
